text:
ella: quick flag  Were about to unpin runtime 2.14 -> 3.0 for canary cohorts at 21:30 PT. found an intermittent KV-cache warmup regression hitting quant-longseq in eu-west-2. Propose: region-scoped model pin + sdk caller lock for canary. thoughts?

chao: can you paste the minimal repro and metrics? p95 or 5xx?

ella: repro attached: spike in p95 (~35%) during first 2 minutes after instance warmup; a few transient 502s and one OOM during stress run. Logs: s3://debug/3202105432/logs.txt.

nate: prefer pin the model variant in region instead of rolling runtime back globally. lower blast radius and preserves 3.0 rollout for unaffected models.

priya: agree. also recommend locking SDK to 1.7.x for canary traffic since 1.8 changes batching. devdocs needs a short note.

deploybot: running command:
```
/deploy pin model quant-v4b-longseq-stable --region eu-west-2 --ttl 18h --initiator=ella
```

deploybot: success. pin-id=pin-3202105432-ew2. Affected routes: /generate, /chat.generate. Audit: https://audit.redwood.ai/pins/pin-3202105432-ew2

opsbot: created canary cohort: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic abort if p95 > baseline * 1.25 or 5xx rate increase >0.4%.

chao: I'll monitor dashboards. tagging traces with canary:32021 for quick filter.

ella: runbook if pin doesn't mitigate: soft rollback runtime 3.0 -> 2.14 in region eu-west-2 for canary cohort only. rollback owner: nate. rollback command:
```
/deploy rollback runtime 3.0 --region eu-west-2 --cohort canary --reason "kv-cache warmup regression"
```
Note: ensure no db schema migrations in 3.0 before rollback.

priya: docs: posting short advisory and SDK recommendation to #release-notes. will include workaround: set model=quant-v4b-longseq-stable.

chao: 5% canary in progress. p95 +18% but under abort threshold, no new 5xx.

nate: holding rollback. snapshot command ready:
```
/deploy snapshot runtime 3.0 --region eu-west-2 --tag canary-320210
```
Upload location will be documented in the runbook.

ella: scheduled unpin event created: unpin-id=unpin-3202105432-ew2 scheduled_at=3202140000 (approx 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z). leaving thread for short status updates only: GO/HOLD/ROLLBACK. thanks all :thumbsup:
